summary: Barrick Mining Corporation filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit containing the Second Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of Nevada Gold Mines LLC, dated August 10, 2026, among Barrick, Barrick Nevada Holding LLC, Newmont Corporation, Newmont USA Limited, and Nevada Gold Mines LLC. This amends the governance, funding, distribution, and default/dilution terms of the Barrick-Newmont Nevada joint venture. No financial terms, share prices, or transaction values are stated. The filing updates the JV's operating framework, including capital contributions, dilution mechanisms, and retained royalties. Watch for operational changes or future capital calls stemming from revised JV terms.
